transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Ever since my father-in-law moved in, I’ve been on edge. I snap at my wife over little things around the house, and I’m putting off jobs and paperwork I normally would handle. Even when I’m out in the workshop or trying to fish, I can’t seem to quiet my head down.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About five months now—since not long after my father-in-law moved in.
Aside from feeling on edge, have you been feeling down, sad, or depressed most of the day?
I’m not really sure I’d call it depressed. I’ve mostly just been tense and wound up.
Are your worries mostly centered around your father-in-law living with you, or do you find yourself constantly worrying about many different areas of your life?
It’s mostly about him living with us and the tension around the house. It gets in my head, and then I’m snapping at my wife or avoiding things I’d normally take care of.
